cards.title: un imprévu (m.)
cards.example: Un imprévu m'a obligé à annuler.
cards.translation: Something unexpected forced me to cancel.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: au cas où
cards.example: Prends un parapluie au cas où il pleuvrait.
cards.translation: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Depuis + present
cards.meaning: Use the present for an action that began earlier and is still continuing.
cards.example: J'habite ici depuis deux ans.
cards.translation: I've lived here for two years.
cards.note: Depuis answers both 'since when?' and 'for how long?' for ongoing situations.

cards.title: une échéance (f.)
cards.example: Nous devons respecter cette échéance.
cards.translation: We have to meet this deadline.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être débordé
cards.example: Je suis débordée cette semaine.
cards.translation: I'm swamped this week.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Passé composé or imparfait?
cards.meaning: Imparfait sets the scene; passé composé presents a completed event.
cards.example: Il pleuvait quand le bus est arrivé.
cards.translation: It was raining when the bus arrived.
cards.note: Use the contrast to tell a story, rather than matching English tenses mechanically.

cards.title: un bail (m.)
cards.example: Le bail se termine en juin.
cards.translation: The lease ends in June.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: se sentir chez soi
cards.example: Je me sens enfin chez moi ici.
cards.translation: I finally feel at home here.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Si + imparfait
cards.meaning: For a hypothetical present or future, use si + imparfait, then the conditional.
cards.example: Si j'avais le temps, je viendrais.
cards.translation: If I had time, I would come.
cards.note: Do not put the conditional directly after si in this pattern.

cards.title: un choix (m.)
cards.example: Ce choix n'a pas été facile.
cards.translation: This choice wasn't easy.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: peser le pour et le contre
cards.meaning: to weigh the pros and cons
cards.example: Prenons le temps de peser le pour et le contre.
cards.translation: Let's take time to weigh the pros and cons.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Polite conditional
cards.meaning: The conditional softens a request or suggestion.
cards.example: Je voudrais un renseignement.
cards.translation: I'd like some information.
cards.note: Voudrais and pourrais are useful for requests; devrais often gives advice.

cards.title: une correspondance (f.)
cards.example: J'ai raté ma correspondance à Lyon.
cards.translation: I missed my connection in Lyon.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire demi-tour
cards.example: La route est fermée, il faut faire demi-tour.
cards.translation: The road is closed; we have to turn back.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Qui or que?
cards.meaning: Qui is the relative subject; que is the relative object.
cards.example: C'est une amie qui habite à Lyon.
cards.translation: She's a friend who lives in Lyon.
cards.note: Que becomes qu' before a vowel. Identify the subject of the relative verb first.

cards.title: un soutien (m.)
cards.example: Son soutien m'a beaucoup aidée.
cards.translation: Her support helped me a lot.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: compter sur quelqu'un
cards.example: Tu peux compter sur moi.
cards.translation: You can count on me.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun y
cards.meaning: Y often replaces à + a thing, or a place introduced by a preposition.
cards.example: Tu vas au marché ? Oui, j'y vais.
cards.translation: Are you going to the market? Yes, I am.
cards.note: With people, penser à usually keeps a stressed pronoun: je pense à elle.

cards.title: le gaspillage (m.)
cards.example: Nous voulons réduire le gaspillage alimentaire.
cards.translation: We want to reduce food waste.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire attention à
cards.meaning: to pay attention to; be careful about
cards.example: Je fais attention à ma consommation d'eau.
cards.translation: I watch how much water I use.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun en
cards.meaning: En replaces de + a thing, and can replace a noun after a quantity.
cards.example: Tu veux du pain ? Oui, j'en veux.
cards.translation: Would you like bread? Yes, I'd like some.
cards.note: Keep the quantity: j'en ai deux, j'en veux beaucoup.

cards.title: un remboursement (m.)
cards.example: J'ai demandé un remboursement.
cards.translation: I asked for a refund.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: valoir le coup
cards.example: Ce manteau est cher, mais il vaut le coup.
cards.translation: This coat is expensive, but it's worth it.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Object pronoun position
cards.meaning: Object pronouns normally go before the verb they belong to.
cards.example: Je le vois demain.
cards.translation: I'm seeing him tomorrow.
cards.note: With two verbs, place the pronoun before the infinitive when it belongs to that infinitive.

cards.title: une compétence (f.)
cards.example: Cette formation développe mes compétences.
cards.translation: This training develops my skills.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avoir du mal à
cards.example: J'ai du mal à comprendre cet accent.
cards.translation: I have trouble understanding this accent.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Direct or indirect object?
cards.meaning: Many verbs take a direct object; téléphoner and parler take à + a person.
cards.example: Je connais Marie. Je la connais.
cards.translation: I know Marie. I know her.
cards.note: Lui can mean 'to him' or 'to her'; leur is the plural indirect object.

cards.title: un délai (m.)
cards.meaning: a period allowed; a time limit
cards.example: Le délai de livraison est de trois jours.
cards.translation: The delivery time is three days.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: prendre son temps
cards.example: Prends ton temps, nous ne sommes pas pressés.
cards.translation: Take your time; we're not in a hurry.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Comparisons
cards.meaning: Use plus, moins, or aussi + adjective + que.
cards.example: Ce trajet est plus court que l'autre.
cards.translation: This route is shorter than the other one.
cards.note: Bon has the comparative meilleur; bien has mieux.

cards.title: une poignée (f.)
cards.example: Ajoute une poignée de noix.
cards.translation: Add a handful of nuts.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: mettre la main à la pâte
cards.example: Tout le monde a mis la main à la pâte.
cards.translation: Everyone lent a hand.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Better: mieux or meilleur?
cards.meaning: Meilleur describes a noun; mieux usually describes how an action is done.
cards.example: Ce pain est meilleur.
cards.translation: This bread is better.
cards.note: Meilleur agrees with the noun: meilleure, meilleurs, meilleures.

cards.title: un rendez-vous (m.)
cards.example: J'ai pris rendez-vous chez le dentiste.
cards.translation: I made a dentist's appointment.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: se remettre de
cards.example: Elle se remet d'une mauvaise grippe.
cards.translation: She's recovering from a bad case of flu.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Future simple
cards.meaning: Use the future simple for predictions, promises, and future events.
cards.example: Je t'appellerai demain.
cards.translation: I'll call you tomorrow.
cards.note: Common irregular stems include ser-, aur-, ir-, fer-, and verr-.

cards.title: une dépense (f.)
cards.example: Il faut prévoir les dépenses du mois.
cards.translation: We need to plan this month's expenses.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: mettre de côté
cards.example: Je mets un peu d'argent de côté.
cards.translation: I put a little money aside.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Quand + future
cards.meaning: For a future situation, French often uses the future in both clauses.
cards.example: Quand tu arriveras, je préparerai le café.
cards.translation: When you arrive, I'll make coffee.
cards.note: English uses a present after 'when'; French normally uses a future here.

cards.title: un avis (m.)
cards.example: Ton avis m'intéresse.
cards.translation: I'm interested in your opinion.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: à mon avis
cards.example: À mon avis, nous devrions attendre.
cards.translation: In my opinion, we should wait.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Venir de + infinitive
cards.meaning: This construction expresses something that has just happened.
cards.example: Je viens de rentrer.
cards.translation: I've just got home.
cards.note: Conjugate venir, then add de and the infinitive.

cards.title: une habitude (f.)
cards.example: J'essaie de changer mes habitudes.
cards.translation: I'm trying to change my habits.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: petit à petit
cards.example: Petit à petit, je prends confiance.
cards.translation: Little by little, I'm gaining confidence.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Pendant or pour?
cards.meaning: Pendant expresses duration; pour can express an intended duration.
cards.example: J'ai attendu pendant une heure.
cards.translation: I waited for an hour.
cards.note: For an action still continuing, use depuis rather than pendant.

cards.title: un trajet (m.)
cards.example: Le trajet dure quarante minutes.
cards.translation: The journey takes forty minutes.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être en panne
cards.example: Le bus est en panne.
cards.translation: The bus has broken down.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Il faut + infinitive
cards.meaning: Use il faut + infinitive to state a general necessity.
cards.example: Il faut réserver à l'avance.
cards.translation: You need to book ahead.
cards.note: Il faut que + a subject requires the subjunctive instead.

cards.title: le voisinage (m.)
cards.example: Le voisinage est très calme.
cards.translation: The neighborhood is very quiet.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: donner un coup de main
cards.example: Tu peux me donner un coup de main ?
cards.translation: Can you give me a hand?
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Subjunctive after il faut que
cards.meaning: Use the subjunctive after il faut que to express necessity for a subject.
cards.example: Il faut que tu viennes.
cards.translation: You need to come.
cards.note: Common forms include sois, aies, ailles, fasses, and viennes.

cards.title: un soulagement (m.)
cards.example: Quel soulagement de te voir !
cards.translation: What a relief to see you!
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: en avoir assez
cards.example: J'en ai assez de ce bruit.
cards.translation: I've had enough of this noise.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Purpose with pour
cards.meaning: Use pour + infinitive when the same person performs both actions.
cards.example: Je marche pour rester en forme.
cards.translation: I walk to stay fit.
cards.note: Pour que + a different subject normally takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: un malentendu (m.)
cards.example: C'était simplement un malentendu.
cards.translation: It was simply a misunderstanding.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: se rendre compte de
cards.example: Je me suis rendu compte de mon erreur.
cards.translation: I realized my mistake.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Because or thanks to?
cards.meaning: Parce que introduces a clause; grâce à introduces a positive cause as a noun.
cards.example: Je reste parce qu'il pleut.
cards.translation: I'm staying because it's raining.
cards.note: À cause de often introduces an unwelcome cause; grâce à a helpful one.

cards.title: une œuvre (f.)
cards.meaning: a work of art or literature
cards.example: Cette œuvre me touche beaucoup.
cards.translation: This work moves me deeply.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avoir lieu
cards.example: Le festival aura lieu en juillet.
cards.translation: The festival will take place in July.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Although with même si
cards.meaning: Même si introduces a concession and normally takes the indicative.
cards.example: Je sors même s'il pleut.
cards.translation: I'm going out even if it's raining.
cards.note: Do not confuse this with bien que, which takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: un mot de passe (m.)
cards.example: J'ai oublié mon mot de passe.
cards.translation: I forgot my password.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: mettre à jour
cards.example: Pense à mettre ton téléphone à jour.
cards.translation: Remember to update your phone.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Negation: ne…plus
cards.example: Je ne travaille plus ici.
cards.translation: I don't work here anymore.
cards.note: In informal speech, ne is often omitted; keep it in careful writing.

cards.title: un sentier (m.)
cards.example: Ce sentier mène au lac.
cards.translation: This trail leads to the lake.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: prendre l'air
cards.example: Allons prendre l'air après le repas.
cards.translation: Let's get some fresh air after lunch.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Negation: ne…jamais
cards.meaning: Ne…jamais means 'never'. In a compound tense, jamais usually follows the auxiliary.
cards.example: Je ne mange jamais ici.
cards.translation: I never eat here.
cards.note: Use déjà in a neutral 'ever' question: tu as déjà essayé ?

cards.title: un entretien (m.)
cards.example: Mon entretien s'est bien passé.
cards.translation: My interview went well.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être à l'aise
cards.meaning: to feel comfortable; be at ease
cards.example: Je suis plus à l'aise à l'oral.
cards.translation: I'm more comfortable speaking.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Restriction: ne…que
cards.meaning: Ne…que means 'only', not a full negation.
cards.example: Je n'ai que dix euros.
cards.translation: I only have ten euros.
cards.note: Place que directly before the restricted element.

cards.title: une source (f.)
cards.example: Il faut vérifier les sources.
cards.translation: We need to check the sources.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: tenir au courant
cards.example: Tiens-moi au courant de la situation.
cards.translation: Keep me informed about the situation.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Reported statements
cards.meaning: Use que to report what someone says or thinks.
cards.example: Elle dit qu'elle est prête.
cards.translation: She says she's ready.
cards.note: Change pronouns as needed. Reporting with a past verb may require tense changes.

cards.title: une démarche (f.)
cards.example: Cette démarche peut se faire en ligne.
cards.translation: This procedure can be completed online.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: s'y prendre à l'avance
cards.example: Il vaut mieux s'y prendre à l'avance.
cards.translation: It's better to plan ahead.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Indirect questions
cards.meaning: An indirect question uses statement word order rather than inversion.
cards.example: Je voudrais savoir où est la gare.
cards.translation: I'd like to know where the station is.
cards.note: Use si for an indirect yes/no question; omit est-ce que.

cards.title: un objectif (m.)
cards.example: Mon objectif est de parler plus souvent.
cards.translation: My goal is to speak more often.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: tenir bon
cards.example: Tiens bon, tu progresses !
cards.translation: Keep going; you're making progress!
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative où
cards.meaning: Où can link a clause to a place or time.
cards.example: C'est la ville où je suis né.
cards.translation: It's the city where I was born.
cards.note: The accent distinguishes où ('where') from ou ('or').

cards.title: un empêchement (m.)
cards.example: J'ai un empêchement ce soir.
cards.translation: Something has come up tonight.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avec plaisir
cards.example: Je viendrai avec plaisir.
cards.translation: I'd be happy to come.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative dont
cards.meaning: Dont can replace de + a complement in a relative clause.
cards.example: C'est le livre dont je t'ai parlé.
cards.translation: It's the book I told you about.
cards.note: Think of the underlying forms: parler de, avoir besoin de, être fier de.

cards.title: une éclaircie (f.)
cards.example: Il y aura des éclaircies cet après-midi.
cards.translation: There will be sunny intervals this afternoon.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: un temps de chien
cards.example: Il fait un temps de chien aujourd'hui.
cards.translation: The weather is awful today.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Agreement with être
cards.meaning: With être, the past participle usually agrees with the subject.
cards.example: Elle est arrivée hier.
cards.translation: She arrived yesterday.
cards.note: Pronominal verbs need extra care; not every reflexive participle agrees automatically.

cards.title: une tâche (f.)
cards.example: Cette tâche prend du temps.
cards.translation: This task takes time.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: au fur et à mesure
cards.example: Je range au fur et à mesure.
cards.translation: I tidy up as I go along.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The gerund: en + -ant
cards.meaning: The gerund often expresses simultaneous actions with the same subject.
cards.example: J'écoute la radio en cuisinant.
cards.translation: I listen to the radio while cooking.
cards.note: Useful irregular forms include en étant, en ayant, and en sachant.

cards.title: un souvenir (m.)
cards.example: Je garde un bon souvenir de ce voyage.
cards.translation: I have fond memories of that trip.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça me rappelle
cards.example: Ça me rappelle mes vacances en Bretagne.
cards.translation: That reminds me of my holidays in Brittany.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Emphasis with c'est…qui
cards.meaning: C'est…qui emphasizes the subject responsible for an action.
cards.example: C'est moi qui ai réservé.
cards.translation: I'm the one who booked.
cards.note: The verb agrees with the emphasized subject: moi qui ai, toi qui as.

cards.title: la confiance (f.)
cards.example: La confiance se construit avec le temps.
cards.translation: Trust is built over time.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: oser se lancer
cards.meaning: to dare to take the plunge
cards.example: Il faut parfois oser se lancer.
cards.translation: Sometimes you have to dare to take the plunge.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Depuis + present
cards.meaning: Use the present for an action that began earlier and is still continuing.
cards.example: Elle apprend le français depuis janvier.
cards.translation: She's been learning French since January.
cards.note: Depuis answers both 'since when?' and 'for how long?' for ongoing situations.

cards.title: un brouillon (m.)
cards.example: J'ai terminé le premier brouillon.
cards.translation: I've finished the first draft.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être en cours
cards.example: Les travaux sont en cours.
cards.translation: The work is underway.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Passé composé or imparfait?
cards.meaning: Imparfait sets the scene; passé composé presents a completed event.
cards.example: Je cuisinais quand elle a appelé.
cards.translation: I was cooking when she called.
cards.note: Use the contrast to tell a story, rather than matching English tenses mechanically.

cards.title: une caution (f.)
cards.meaning: a guarantor; commonly, a rental deposit
cards.example: L'agence demande une caution.
cards.translation: The agency asks for a guarantor or deposit.
cards.note: Neutral. Strictly a guarantor; often used for a rental deposit. Dépôt de garantie is precise for the deposit.

cards.title: faire l'état des lieux
cards.example: Nous faisons l'état des lieux demain.
cards.translation: We're doing the property inspection tomorrow.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Si + imparfait
cards.meaning: For a hypothetical present or future, use si + imparfait, then the conditional.
cards.example: Si nous habitions plus près, ce serait pratique.
cards.translation: If we lived closer, it would be convenient.
cards.note: Do not put the conditional directly after si in this pattern.

cards.title: un désaccord (m.)
cards.example: Nous avons un désaccord sur le budget.
cards.translation: We disagree about the budget.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ne pas être du même avis
cards.example: Je ne suis pas du même avis.
cards.translation: I don't share that opinion.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Polite conditional
cards.meaning: The conditional softens a request or suggestion.
cards.example: Pourriez-vous répéter, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.translation: Could you repeat that, please?
cards.note: Voudrais and pourrais are useful for requests; devrais often gives advice.

cards.title: un détour (m.)
cards.example: Les travaux nous obligent à faire un détour.
cards.translation: The roadworks force us to take a detour.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: en avoir pour
cards.meaning: to need a certain amount of time
cards.example: On en a pour une heure.
cards.translation: It will take us an hour.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Qui or que?
cards.meaning: Qui is the relative subject; que is the relative object.
cards.example: Voici le livre que je cherche.
cards.translation: Here's the book I'm looking for.
cards.note: Que becomes qu' before a vowel. Identify the subject of the relative verb first.

cards.title: un lien (m.)
cards.example: Nous avons gardé des liens très forts.
cards.translation: We've maintained very strong bonds.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: prendre des nouvelles
cards.meaning: to ask how someone is doing
cards.example: J'appelle pour prendre de tes nouvelles.
cards.translation: I'm calling to see how you're doing.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun y
cards.meaning: Y often replaces à + a thing, or a place introduced by a preposition.
cards.example: Je pense à ce problème. J'y pense souvent.
cards.translation: I think about this problem. I think about it often.
cards.note: With people, penser à usually keeps a stressed pronoun: je pense à elle.

cards.title: le tri (m.)
cards.example: Le tri des déchets est obligatoire ici.
cards.translation: Sorting waste is compulsory here.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire le tri
cards.example: Je fais le tri dans mes vêtements.
cards.translation: I'm sorting through my clothes.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun en
cards.meaning: En replaces de + a thing, and can replace a noun after a quantity.
cards.example: J'ai trois billets. J'en ai trois.
cards.translation: I have three tickets. I have three of them.
cards.note: Keep the quantity: j'en ai deux, j'en veux beaucoup.

cards.title: une garantie (f.)
cards.example: Cet appareil est encore sous garantie.
cards.translation: This appliance is still under warranty.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire une bonne affaire
cards.example: J'ai fait une bonne affaire au marché.
cards.translation: I got a good deal at the market.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Object pronoun position
cards.meaning: Object pronouns normally go before the verb they belong to.
cards.example: Je vais lui téléphoner.
cards.translation: I'm going to phone her.
cards.note: With two verbs, place the pronoun before the infinitive when it belongs to that infinitive.

cards.title: une lacune (f.)
cards.example: J'ai quelques lacunes en grammaire.
cards.translation: I have a few gaps in my grammar knowledge.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: apprendre par cœur
cards.example: Je n'aime pas apprendre des listes par cœur.
cards.translation: I don't like learning lists by heart.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Direct or indirect object?
cards.meaning: Many verbs take a direct object; téléphoner and parler take à + a person.
cards.example: Je téléphone à Paul. Je lui téléphone.
cards.translation: I phone Paul. I phone him.
cards.note: Lui can mean 'to him' or 'to her'; leur is the plural indirect object.

cards.title: une attente (f.)
cards.example: L'attente a été plus longue que prévu.
cards.translation: The wait was longer than expected.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça dépend
cards.example: Ça dépend du temps qu'il fera.
cards.translation: It depends on what the weather will be like.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Comparisons
cards.meaning: Use plus, moins, or aussi + adjective + que.
cards.example: Cette chambre est aussi claire que la mienne.
cards.translation: This room is as bright as mine.
cards.note: Bon has the comparative meilleur; bien has mieux.

cards.title: un assaisonnement (m.)
cards.example: Goûte pour vérifier l'assaisonnement.
cards.translation: Taste it to check the seasoning.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avoir l'eau à la bouche
cards.example: Cette odeur me met l'eau à la bouche.
cards.translation: That smell makes my mouth water.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Better: mieux or meilleur?
cards.meaning: Meilleur describes a noun; mieux usually describes how an action is done.
cards.example: Je comprends mieux maintenant.
cards.translation: I understand better now.
cards.note: Meilleur agrees with the noun: meilleure, meilleurs, meilleures.

cards.title: le repos (m.)
cards.example: Tu as besoin de repos.
cards.translation: You need some rest.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être en pleine forme
cards.meaning: to feel great; be very fit
cards.example: Après ces vacances, je suis en pleine forme.
cards.translation: After that holiday, I feel great.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Future simple
cards.meaning: Use the future simple for predictions, promises, and future events.
cards.example: Nous verrons cela plus tard.
cards.translation: We'll look at that later.
cards.note: Common irregular stems include ser-, aur-, ir-, fer-, and verr-.

cards.title: une épargne (f.)
cards.example: Cette épargne servira à financer le voyage.
cards.translation: These savings will help pay for the trip.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: joindre les deux bouts
cards.example: Il est difficile de joindre les deux bouts.
cards.translation: It's hard to make ends meet.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Quand + future
cards.meaning: For a future situation, French often uses the future in both clauses.
cards.example: Dès que je saurai, je te dirai.
cards.translation: As soon as I know, I'll tell you.
cards.note: English uses a present after 'when'; French normally uses a future here.

cards.title: un point de vue (m.)
cards.example: Je comprends ton point de vue.
cards.translation: I understand your point of view.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: cela dit
cards.example: C'est cher. Cela dit, la qualité est bonne.
cards.translation: It's expensive. That said, the quality is good.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Venir de + infinitive
cards.meaning: This construction expresses something that has just happened.
cards.example: Elle vient de terminer son travail.
cards.translation: She's just finished her work.
cards.note: Conjugate venir, then add de and the infinitive.

cards.title: un rythme (m.)
cards.example: J'ai trouvé mon rythme.
cards.translation: I've found my rhythm.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: de temps en temps
cards.example: Je travaille de chez moi de temps en temps.
cards.translation: I work from home from time to time.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Pendant or pour?
cards.meaning: Pendant expresses duration; pour can express an intended duration.
cards.example: Je pars pour trois jours.
cards.translation: I'm going away for three days.
cards.note: For an action still continuing, use depuis rather than pendant.

cards.title: un abonnement (m.)
cards.example: Mon abonnement expire demain.
cards.translation: My season ticket expires tomorrow.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être à l'heure
cards.example: Pour une fois, le train est à l'heure.
cards.translation: For once, the train is on time.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Il faut + infinitive
cards.meaning: Use il faut + infinitive to state a general necessity.
cards.example: Il faut prendre le temps de réfléchir.
cards.translation: You need to take time to think.
cards.note: Il faut que + a subject requires the subjunctive instead.

cards.title: une entraide (f.)
cards.example: L'entraide est importante dans ce quartier.
cards.translation: Mutual support matters in this neighborhood.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: rendre service
cards.example: Merci, tu me rends vraiment service.
cards.translation: Thanks; you're really helping me out.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Subjunctive after il faut que
cards.meaning: Use the subjunctive after il faut que to express necessity for a subject.
cards.example: Il faut que nous partions tôt.
cards.translation: We need to leave early.
cards.note: Common forms include sois, aies, ailles, fasses, and viennes.

cards.title: une déception (f.)
cards.example: Son départ a été une déception.
cards.translation: Her departure was a disappointment.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avoir le moral
cards.example: Malgré la pluie, j'ai le moral.
cards.translation: Despite the rain, I'm in good spirits.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Purpose with pour
cards.meaning: Use pour + infinitive when the same person performs both actions.
cards.example: Elle économise pour voyager.
cards.translation: She's saving to travel.
cards.note: Pour que + a different subject normally takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: une précision (f.)
cards.example: J'aurais besoin d'une précision.
cards.translation: I could use a clarification.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: si j'ai bien compris
cards.example: Si j'ai bien compris, on part demain.
cards.translation: If I've understood correctly, we're leaving tomorrow.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Because or thanks to?
cards.meaning: Parce que introduces a clause; grâce à introduces a positive cause as a noun.
cards.example: Grâce à ton aide, j'ai terminé.
cards.translation: Thanks to your help, I've finished.
cards.note: À cause de often introduces an unwelcome cause; grâce à a helpful one.

cards.title: une séance (f.)
cards.example: La prochaine séance commence à vingt heures.
cards.translation: The next screening starts at eight p.m.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça vaut le détour
cards.example: Ce petit musée vaut le détour.
cards.translation: This small museum is worth a special trip.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Although with même si
cards.meaning: Même si introduces a concession and normally takes the indicative.
cards.example: Même si c'est cher, je vais l'acheter.
cards.translation: Even though it's expensive, I'm going to buy it.
cards.note: Do not confuse this with bien que, which takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: une pièce jointe (f.)
cards.example: Le document est en pièce jointe.
cards.translation: The document is attached.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire une sauvegarde
cards.example: Fais une sauvegarde avant la mise à jour.
cards.translation: Make a backup before the update.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Negation: ne…plus
cards.example: Nous n'avons plus de lait.
cards.translation: We have no milk left.
cards.note: In informal speech, ne is often omitted; keep it in careful writing.

cards.title: un paysage (m.)
cards.example: Le paysage change au fil des saisons.
cards.translation: The landscape changes with the seasons.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: en plein air
cards.example: Nous avons déjeuné en plein air.
cards.translation: We had lunch outdoors.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Negation: ne…jamais
cards.meaning: Ne…jamais means 'never'. In a compound tense, jamais usually follows the auxiliary.
cards.example: Je n'ai jamais vu ce film.
cards.translation: I've never seen this film.
cards.note: Use déjà in a neutral 'ever' question: tu as déjà essayé ?

cards.title: une candidature (f.)
cards.meaning: an application for a job or position
cards.example: J'ai envoyé ma candidature hier.
cards.translation: I sent my application yesterday.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire le point
cards.meaning: to take stock; review the situation
cards.example: Faisons le point sur tes projets.
cards.translation: Let's take stock of your plans.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Restriction: ne…que
cards.meaning: Ne…que means 'only', not a full negation.
cards.example: Elle ne vient que le lundi.
cards.translation: She only comes on Mondays.
cards.note: Place que directly before the restricted element.

cards.title: une rumeur (f.)
cards.example: Cette rumeur n'a pas été confirmée.
cards.translation: This rumor hasn't been confirmed.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: à ce qu'il paraît
cards.example: À ce qu'il paraît, le magasin va fermer.
cards.translation: Apparently, the shop is going to close.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Reported statements
cards.meaning: Use que to report what someone says or thinks.
cards.example: Je pense que c'est possible.
cards.translation: I think it's possible.
cards.note: Change pronouns as needed. Reporting with a past verb may require tense changes.

cards.title: un justificatif (m.)
cards.example: Il faut un justificatif de domicile.
cards.translation: You need proof of address.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: remplir un formulaire
cards.example: Vous devez remplir ce formulaire.
cards.translation: You must fill in this form.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Indirect questions
cards.meaning: An indirect question uses statement word order rather than inversion.
cards.example: Tu sais quand il arrive ?
cards.translation: Do you know when he's arriving?
cards.note: Use si for an indirect yes/no question; omit est-ce que.

cards.title: un progrès (m.)
cards.example: Tu as fait beaucoup de progrès.
cards.translation: You've made a lot of progress.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça en vaut la peine
cards.example: C'est difficile, mais ça en vaut la peine.
cards.translation: It's difficult, but it's worth the effort.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative où
cards.meaning: Où can link a clause to a place or time.
cards.example: Je me souviens du jour où nous sommes partis.
cards.translation: I remember the day we left.
cards.note: The accent distinguishes où ('where') from ou ('or').

cards.title: une occasion (f.)
cards.example: C'est une bonne occasion de discuter.
cards.translation: It's a good opportunity to talk.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: à l'occasion
cards.example: On pourrait déjeuner ensemble à l'occasion.
cards.translation: We could have lunch together sometime.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative dont
cards.meaning: Dont can replace de + a complement in a relative clause.
cards.example: Voici le document dont j'ai besoin.
cards.translation: Here's the document I need.
cards.note: Think of the underlying forms: parler de, avoir besoin de, être fier de.

cards.title: une averse (f.)
cards.example: Une averse nous a surpris.
cards.translation: We were caught in a shower.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être trempé jusqu'aux os
cards.meaning: to be soaked to the skin
cards.example: Sans parapluie, j'étais trempé jusqu'aux os.
cards.translation: Without an umbrella, I was soaked to the skin.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Agreement with être
cards.meaning: With être, the past participle usually agrees with the subject.
cards.example: Ils sont partis tôt.
cards.translation: They left early.
cards.note: Pronominal verbs need extra care; not every reflexive participle agrees automatically.

cards.title: une priorité (f.)
cards.example: Le logement est notre priorité.
cards.translation: Housing is our priority.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: chaque chose en son temps
cards.example: Chaque chose en son temps : finissons ceci.
cards.translation: One thing at a time: let's finish this.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The gerund: en + -ant
cards.meaning: The gerund often expresses simultaneous actions with the same subject.
cards.example: Elle apprend en pratiquant.
cards.translation: She learns by practicing.
cards.note: Useful irregular forms include en étant, en ayant, and en sachant.

cards.title: une époque (f.)
cards.example: À cette époque, je vivais à Lille.
cards.translation: At that time, I lived in Lille.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça fait longtemps
cards.example: Ça fait longtemps qu'on ne s'est pas vus.
cards.translation: It's been a long time since we saw each other.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Emphasis with c'est…qui
cards.meaning: C'est…qui emphasizes the subject responsible for an action.
cards.example: C'est toi qui choisis.
cards.translation: You're the one who chooses.
cards.note: The verb agrees with the emphasized subject: moi qui ai, toi qui as.

cards.title: une démarche (f.)
cards.meaning: an approach; a course of action
cards.example: J'apprécie ta démarche.
cards.translation: I appreciate your approach.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: prendre les devants
cards.example: J'ai pris les devants et réservé une table.
cards.translation: I took the initiative and booked a table.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Depuis + present
cards.meaning: Use the present for an action that began earlier and is still continuing.
cards.example: Nous attendons depuis une heure.
cards.translation: We've been waiting for an hour.
cards.note: Depuis answers both 'since when?' and 'for how long?' for ongoing situations.

cards.title: une répartition (f.)
cards.example: La répartition des tâches est équitable.
cards.translation: The allocation of tasks is fair.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: se mettre d'accord
cards.example: Il faut se mettre d'accord sur une date.
cards.translation: We need to agree on a date.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Passé composé or imparfait?
cards.meaning: Imparfait sets the scene; passé composé presents a completed event.
cards.example: Nous marchions quand l'orage a commencé.
cards.translation: We were walking when the storm began.
cards.note: Use the contrast to tell a story, rather than matching English tenses mechanically.

cards.title: une fuite (f.)
cards.example: Il y a une fuite sous l'évier.
cards.translation: There's a leak under the sink.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire appel à
cards.meaning: to call on; seek help from
cards.example: Nous avons fait appel à un plombier.
cards.translation: We called a plumber.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Si + imparfait
cards.meaning: For a hypothetical present or future, use si + imparfait, then the conditional.
cards.example: Si tu voulais, on pourrait partir tôt.
cards.translation: If you wanted, we could leave early.
cards.note: Do not put the conditional directly after si in this pattern.

cards.title: un compromis (m.)
cards.example: Nous avons trouvé un compromis.
cards.translation: We've found a compromise.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: tant qu'à faire
cards.meaning: while we're at it; if we're going to do it
cards.example: Tant qu'à faire, restons tout le week-end.
cards.translation: While we're at it, let's stay all weekend.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Polite conditional
cards.meaning: The conditional softens a request or suggestion.
cards.example: Tu devrais te reposer.
cards.translation: You should rest.
cards.note: Voudrais and pourrais are useful for requests; devrais often gives advice.

cards.title: un repère (m.)
cards.example: L'église nous sert de repère.
cards.translation: The church serves as our landmark.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: se perdre
cards.example: On s'est perdus dans les petites rues.
cards.translation: We got lost in the little streets.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Qui or que?
cards.meaning: Qui is the relative subject; que is the relative object.
cards.example: Le train qui arrive est le nôtre.
cards.translation: The train that's arriving is ours.
cards.note: Que becomes qu' before a vowel. Identify the subject of the relative verb first.

cards.title: une attention (f.)
cards.example: C'est une délicate attention.
cards.translation: That's a thoughtful gesture.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça me fait plaisir
cards.example: Ça me fait plaisir de te revoir.
cards.translation: I'm happy to see you again.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun y
cards.meaning: Y often replaces à + a thing, or a place introduced by a preposition.
cards.example: Elle habite en France et elle y travaille.
cards.translation: She lives in France and works there.
cards.note: With people, penser à usually keeps a stressed pronoun: je pense à elle.

cards.title: une ressource (f.)
cards.example: Il faut préserver les ressources naturelles.
cards.translation: We need to preserve natural resources.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: autant que possible
cards.example: J'évite le plastique autant que possible.
cards.translation: I avoid plastic as much as possible.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The pronoun en
cards.meaning: En replaces de + a thing, and can replace a noun after a quantity.
cards.example: Tu parles de ton voyage ? Oui, j'en parle.
cards.translation: Are you talking about your trip? Yes, I am.
cards.note: Keep the quantity: j'en ai deux, j'en veux beaucoup.

cards.title: un rapport qualité-prix (m.)
cards.example: Ce restaurant offre un bon rapport qualité-prix.
cards.translation: This restaurant offers good value for money.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: à première vue
cards.meaning: at first sight; at first glance
cards.example: À première vue, tout semble en bon état.
cards.translation: At first glance, everything looks in good condition.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Object pronoun position
cards.meaning: Object pronouns normally go before the verb they belong to.
cards.example: Tu peux m'aider ?
cards.translation: Can you help me?
cards.note: With two verbs, place the pronoun before the infinitive when it belongs to that infinitive.

cards.title: un acquis (m.)
cards.example: Il faut consolider ses acquis.
cards.translation: You need to consolidate what you've learned.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: à force de
cards.example: À force de pratiquer, je parle mieux.
cards.translation: Through practice, I speak better.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Direct or indirect object?
cards.meaning: Many verbs take a direct object; téléphoner and parler take à + a person.
cards.example: Je parle à mes voisins. Je leur parle.
cards.translation: I talk to my neighbors. I talk to them.
cards.note: Lui can mean 'to him' or 'to her'; leur is the plural indirect object.

cards.title: un créneau (m.)
cards.example: J'ai un créneau libre jeudi.
cards.translation: I have a free slot on Thursday.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: d'ici là
cards.example: D'ici là, j'aurai fini le dossier.
cards.translation: By then, I'll have finished the file.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Comparisons
cards.meaning: Use plus, moins, or aussi + adjective + que.
cards.example: Le train est moins cher que l'avion.
cards.translation: The train is cheaper than the plane.
cards.note: Bon has the comparative meilleur; bien has mieux.

cards.title: une addition (f.)
cards.example: L'addition est déjà réglée.
cards.translation: The bill has already been paid.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: c'est ma tournée
cards.example: Ne paie pas, c'est ma tournée.
cards.translation: Don't pay; it's my round.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Better: mieux or meilleur?
cards.meaning: Meilleur describes a noun; mieux usually describes how an action is done.
cards.example: Cette solution me semble meilleure.
cards.translation: This solution seems better to me.
cards.note: Meilleur agrees with the noun: meilleure, meilleurs, meilleures.

cards.title: le bien-être (m.)
cards.example: La marche contribue à mon bien-être.
cards.translation: Walking contributes to my wellbeing.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: lever le pied
cards.example: Tu devrais lever le pied ce week-end.
cards.translation: You should take it easy this weekend.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Future simple
cards.meaning: Use the future simple for predictions, promises, and future events.
cards.example: Il fera beau dimanche.
cards.translation: The weather will be nice on Sunday.
cards.note: Common irregular stems include ser-, aur-, ir-, fer-, and verr-.

cards.title: un prélèvement (m.)
cards.example: Le prélèvement a lieu le cinq du mois.
cards.translation: The direct debit is taken on the fifth of the month.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être à découvert
cards.example: Je fais attention à ne pas être à découvert.
cards.translation: I'm careful not to go overdrawn.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Quand + future
cards.meaning: For a future situation, French often uses the future in both clauses.
cards.example: Nous sortirons quand il fera moins chaud.
cards.translation: We'll go out when it's cooler.
cards.note: English uses a present after 'when'; French normally uses a future here.

cards.title: un argument (m.)
cards.example: Ton argument est convaincant.
cards.translation: Your argument is convincing.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: en revanche
cards.example: C'est petit. En revanche, c'est lumineux.
cards.translation: It's small. On the other hand, it's bright.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Venir de + infinitive
cards.meaning: This construction expresses something that has just happened.
cards.example: Nous venons de recevoir la réponse.
cards.translation: We've just received the answer.
cards.note: Conjugate venir, then add de and the infinitive.

cards.title: un changement (m.)
cards.example: Ce changement me fait du bien.
cards.translation: This change is doing me good.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: s'habituer à
cards.example: Je m'habitue à mon nouveau quartier.
cards.translation: I'm getting used to my new neighborhood.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Pendant or pour?
cards.meaning: Pendant expresses duration; pour can express an intended duration.
cards.example: Nous avons discuté pendant tout le trajet.
cards.translation: We talked throughout the journey.
cards.note: For an action still continuing, use depuis rather than pendant.

cards.title: un quai (m.)
cards.example: Le train part du quai numéro trois.
cards.translation: The train leaves from platform three.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être sur le point de
cards.example: Le train est sur le point de partir.
cards.translation: The train is about to leave.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Il faut + infinitive
cards.meaning: Use il faut + infinitive to state a general necessity.
cards.example: Il faut vérifier l'adresse.
cards.translation: You need to check the address.
cards.note: Il faut que + a subject requires the subjunctive instead.

cards.title: le bénévolat (m.)
cards.example: Je fais du bénévolat le samedi.
cards.translation: I volunteer on Saturdays.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: de bon cœur
cards.example: Je t'aide de bon cœur.
cards.translation: I'm happy to help you.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Subjunctive after il faut que
cards.meaning: Use the subjunctive after il faut que to express necessity for a subject.
cards.example: Il faut qu'elle soit là.
cards.translation: She needs to be there.
cards.note: Common forms include sois, aies, ailles, fasses, and viennes.

cards.title: une inquiétude (f.)
cards.example: Je comprends ton inquiétude.
cards.translation: I understand your concern.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ne pas baisser les bras
cards.example: Malgré les difficultés, elle ne baisse pas les bras.
cards.translation: Despite the difficulties, she doesn't give up.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Purpose with pour
cards.meaning: Use pour + infinitive when the same person performs both actions.
cards.example: Nous appelons pour confirmer.
cards.translation: We're calling to confirm.
cards.note: Pour que + a different subject normally takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: un renseignement (m.)
cards.example: Je voudrais un renseignement, s'il vous plaît.
cards.translation: I'd like some information, please.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: autrement dit
cards.example: Autrement dit, il faut tout recommencer.
cards.translation: In other words, we have to start again.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Because or thanks to?
cards.meaning: Parce que introduces a clause; grâce à introduces a positive cause as a noun.
cards.example: Le train est annulé à cause de la neige.
cards.translation: The train is canceled because of the snow.
cards.note: À cause de often introduces an unwelcome cause; grâce à a helpful one.

cards.title: un récit (m.)
cards.example: Son récit m'a donné envie de voyager.
cards.translation: Her account made me want to travel.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: avoir hâte de
cards.meaning: to look forward to; be eager to
cards.example: J'ai hâte de lire la suite.
cards.translation: I can't wait to read the rest.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Although with même si
cards.meaning: Même si introduces a concession and normally takes the indicative.
cards.example: Elle sourit même si elle est fatiguée.
cards.translation: She smiles even though she's tired.
cards.note: Do not confuse this with bien que, which takes the subjunctive.

cards.title: un réglage (m.)
cards.example: J'ai modifié les réglages de l'écran.
cards.translation: I changed the screen settings.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: au lieu de
cards.example: Appelle-moi au lieu d'envoyer un message.
cards.translation: Call me instead of sending a message.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Negation: ne…plus
cards.example: Elle ne prend plus le bus.
cards.translation: She no longer takes the bus.
cards.note: In informal speech, ne is often omitted; keep it in careful writing.

cards.title: une randonnée (f.)
cards.example: Nous préparons une randonnée en montagne.
cards.translation: We're planning a mountain hike.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: ça monte
cards.example: Attention, ça monte après le pont !
cards.translation: Careful; it's uphill after the bridge!
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Negation: ne…jamais
cards.meaning: Ne…jamais means 'never'. In a compound tense, jamais usually follows the auxiliary.
cards.example: Elle n'est jamais allée à Nice.
cards.translation: She's never been to Nice.
cards.note: Use déjà in a neutral 'ever' question: tu as déjà essayé ?

cards.title: une responsabilité (f.)
cards.example: Ce poste implique des responsabilités.
cards.translation: This position involves responsibilities.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: être à la hauteur
cards.meaning: to be up to the task
cards.example: J'espère être à la hauteur.
cards.translation: I hope I'll be up to the task.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Restriction: ne…que
cards.meaning: Ne…que means 'only', not a full negation.
cards.example: Nous ne restons que deux jours.
cards.translation: We're only staying two days.
cards.note: Place que directly before the restricted element.

cards.title: un enjeu (m.)
cards.meaning: a stake; an issue that matters
cards.example: Les enjeux de cette décision sont importants.
cards.translation: A lot is at stake in this decision.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: prendre du recul
cards.example: J'ai besoin de prendre du recul.
cards.translation: I need to step back and gain perspective.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Reported statements
cards.meaning: Use que to report what someone says or thinks.
cards.example: Il explique que le magasin est fermé.
cards.translation: He explains that the shop is closed.
cards.note: Change pronouns as needed. Reporting with a past verb may require tense changes.

cards.title: un guichet (m.)
cards.meaning: a service counter; a ticket window
cards.example: Le guichet ferme à midi.
cards.translation: The counter closes at noon.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faire la queue
cards.example: Nous avons fait la queue pendant vingt minutes.
cards.translation: We stood in line for twenty minutes.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Indirect questions
cards.meaning: An indirect question uses statement word order rather than inversion.
cards.example: Je me demande si elle viendra.
cards.translation: I wonder whether she'll come.
cards.note: Use si for an indirect yes/no question; omit est-ce que.

cards.title: une réussite (f.)
cards.example: Cette soirée a été une réussite.
cards.translation: The evening was a success.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: aller jusqu'au bout
cards.example: Je veux aller jusqu'au bout de ce projet.
cards.translation: I want to see this project through.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative où
cards.meaning: Où can link a clause to a place or time.
cards.example: Voici le café où nous nous retrouvons.
cards.translation: Here's the café where we meet.
cards.note: The accent distinguishes où ('where') from ou ('or').

cards.title: un accueil (m.)
cards.example: Merci pour votre accueil chaleureux.
cards.translation: Thank you for your warm welcome.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faites comme chez vous
cards.example: Entrez et faites comme chez vous.
cards.translation: Come in and make yourself at home.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Relative dont
cards.meaning: Dont can replace de + a complement in a relative clause.
cards.example: C'est une réussite dont elle est fière.
cards.translation: It's an achievement she's proud of.
cards.note: Think of the underlying forms: parler de, avoir besoin de, être fier de.

cards.title: la sécheresse (f.)
cards.example: La sécheresse touche toute la région.
cards.translation: The drought is affecting the whole region.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: faute de
cards.example: Faute de pluie, les plantes souffrent.
cards.translation: For lack of rain, the plants are suffering.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: Agreement with être
cards.meaning: With être, the past participle usually agrees with the subject.
cards.example: Nous sommes restées à la maison.
cards.translation: We stayed at home. (All-female group.)
cards.note: Pronominal verbs need extra care; not every reflexive participle agrees automatically.

cards.title: un rangement (m.)
cards.example: Cette pièce manque de rangements.
cards.translation: This room lacks storage space.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: au quotidien
cards.meaning: in everyday life; on a daily basis
cards.example: Ce petit outil m'aide au quotidien.
cards.translation: This little tool helps me in everyday life.
cards.note: Everyday register. Practise this expression as a complete phrase.

cards.title: The gerund: en + -ant
cards.meaning: The gerund often expresses simultaneous actions with the same subject.
cards.example: Nous parlions en marchant.
cards.translation: We were talking while walking.
cards.note: Useful irregular forms include en étant, en ayant, and en sachant.

cards.title: un souhait (m.)
cards.example: Mon souhait est de continuer à apprendre.
cards.translation: My wish is to keep learning.
cards.note: Neutral register. Learn the word with its example. Noun gender is shown as m. or f.

cards.title: on verra bien
cards.example: Je vais essayer, et on verra bien.
cards.translation: I'll try, and we'll see.
cards.note: Conversational register. Natural with friends and colleagues; use care in formal writing.

cards.title: Emphasis with c'est…qui
cards.meaning: C'est…qui emphasizes the subject responsible for an action.
cards.example: Ce sont eux qui organisent la fête.
cards.translation: They're the ones organizing the party.
cards.note: The verb agrees with the emphasized subject: moi qui ai, toi qui as.
